creator: Alexander Terp
description:
With `split()` and `replace()` literal by default (sprint card `literal-string-defaults`), `escape_regex()` is no longer the fix for the regex-always friction - the friction is gone. What survives is the narrower case of *building* a pattern from parts, where the fixed half is authored and the variable half is not:

```rad
matches(name, "^" + escape_regex(prefix) + ".*")
replace(text, escape_regex(needle) + "\s*$", "", regex=true)
```

`regexp.QuoteMeta` is the implementation. Docs-first: `docs/funcs/escape_regex.md` to the contract in `docs/funcs/README.md`, then `make generate`, then register `FUNC_ESCAPE_REGEX` in `core/funcs.go` (`FUNC_UPPER` at `core/funcs.go:536` is the smallest inline form).

Worth confirming there's real demand before building it. The original motivating consumer no longer needs it: `fr` hand-rolled the helper only to write `text.split(escape_regex(needle)).join(replacement)`, which is now just `text.replace(needle, replacement)`. If nothing else in the corpus wants pattern-building, this card can be closed unbuilt.
title: Add escape_regex() for pattern-building
